_note: case-session-with-parties-and-minutes (C12, ADR-118, decision 191). A case type declares the sessions a case of it holds (a hearing, a zitting, an inspection talk) in `sessions[]`, so a procedure that needs a session with parties and minutes declares one instead of shipping a class. SessionDefinition is the single authority on the entry shape; these properties only have to exist, because OpenRegister stores no undeclared key. The session record carries `sessionKey`, the `sessions[]` entry it belongs to, and `title`. `calendarProvider` shows sessions in Nextcloud Calendar through OpenRegister's virtual calendar, which reads the record under the viewer's own rights.

sessions.title: Sessions
sessions.description: The sessions a case of this type holds with its parties: who is invited, how long before the session the file opens for inspection, whether a party may waive it, and whether minutes and recording consent are required.

key.title: Session key
key.description: The session key, written on each session as `sessionKey`.

label.title: Label
label.description: What the session is called on screen and in the calendar.

inviteeRoles.title: Invitee roles
inviteeRoles.description: The party roles that may be invited. Empty means any role.

minInvitees.title: Minimum invitees
minInvitees.description: How many invitees a session needs at least.

inspectionFloorDays.title: Inspection days before the session
inspectionFloorDays.description: Days before the session that the file is open for inspection. A session cannot be planned closer than this.

waivable.title: Can be waived
waivable.description: Whether a party may waive the session.

minutesRequired.title: Minutes required
minutesRequired.description: Whether a session can only be closed with minutes (a summary or a document).

recordingConsentRequired.title: Recording consent required
recordingConsentRequired.description: Whether an audio recording is accepted only with recording consent granted.

attendanceGraceHours.title: Attendance grace hours
attendanceGraceHours.description: Hours after the session start during which attendance can be added without a correction reason.

statuses.title: Status names
statuses.description: The session status written at each step, when the case type uses other names than the defaults.

planned.title: Planned
planned.description: The status written when the session is planned.

waived.title: Waived
waived.description: The status written when a party waives the session.

executed.title: Held
executed.description: The status written when the session has been held.

cancelled.title: Cancelled
cancelled.description: The status written when the session is cancelled.

sessionKey.title: Session
sessionKey.description: The `sessions[]` entry of the case type this session belongs to.

title.title: Title
title.description: What the session is called, from the case type's session label. Shown in the calendar.
